dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge curve following a parabolic spline from the posterior dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex classification with a pixel radius of approximately 12 pixels.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximate 35-degree posterior tilt relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.7:1 ratio of pixel base width to maximum vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius convex arc forming the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, blunt beak; length is approximately 0.2x the height of the melon at the inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 155 degrees at the melon-rostrum transition point.

other_distinctive_markers: Vivid cyan-green luminescence across the entire body surface with high-luminance white saturation zones along the dorsal and lateral axes.
